[Case ID:21758925371]*Your Help Needed* You’re invited to the Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) Program US
 Greetings from Amazon,
This is a friendly reminder that we are still waiting for your feedback on our request to provide the necessary information. Please let us know if we can be of any further assistance.
-- Original Message --
Greetings from Fulfillment by Amazon,
I am an Amazon associate extending an invitation to you, on behalf of our research team for FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) Program US.
Our program research team has identified you as a Seller that is not currently enrolled to our program. You may or may not potentially sell Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) products at this time, however you may be a Seller who would like to grow their business by starting to sell Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) ASIN(s) through Fulfillment By Amazon. Enrollment into the FBA Dangerous Goods Hazmat program allows sellers to continue offering/selling ASIN(s) on Fulfillment by Amazon, that have been reviewed and classified as Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) and are approved for sale through FBA.
What are dangerous goods? Dangerous goods (also called hazardous materials, or hazmat) are substances or materials that may pose a risk to health, safety, property, or the environment while storing, handling, or transporting because they contain flammable, pressurized, corrosive, or otherwise harmful substances. This may include many consumer-grade products such as perfumes, beauty products, household cleaners, and spray paints.
For more information on dangerous goods, visit our help pages in Seller Central:
- FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/help.html?itemID=ZLZBQ7W6QZRKWWK
- Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) Program Terms and Conditions: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/GYS2KBEE7MYVCGE3
- Dangerous Goods Identification Guide: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G201003400
- Examples of Amazon Products that may be regulated as dangerous goods: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G200525640
- FBA Dangerous Goods Review Process: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G201749580
You can use the look up ASIN tool at any time to check the classification status of your ASIN and whether you need to be in the FBA Dangerous Goods program to sell it. Enter your ASIN in the “Look up an ASIN” tool found by searching “Dangerous Goods” or “Hazmat” in Seller Central help, or you can access it here: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G201003400
FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) FC’s are specifically designed to safely process and store DG Hazmat inventory. At this time, the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) Program is by invitation only to select participants in US. Storage is limited to FBA Seller’s enrolled to the DG Hazmat program, and that are actively utilizing their physical storage space. Utilization of a Seller’s allocated storage space is assessed regularly.
If you choose “Yes” to enroll to the program, your hazardous materials storage limit will be 10 Cubic Feet Flammable storage, and 05 Cubic Feet Aerosol storage.
Please respond by 2026-09-01 with a definitive 'YES' to accept IF you would like to enroll or 'No' if you wish to decline. Once we receive your decision to enroll, there will be no action required on your part until your enrollment to the program has been finalized. You will receive a confirmation email, when your Seller account has been enabled.
There is not an enrollment fee to join the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program. Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) items that are classified and approved to be sold only through the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program require special handling and hazardous materials (hazmat) storage. Effective February 15, 2019, Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) introduced separate monthly storage fees for Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) items sold through the FBA Dangerous Goods program. This change will first be reflected in April 2019 charges for storage that occurs in March 2019. Monthly inventory storage fees for other products will not change. Fulfillment fees for items sold through the FBA Dangerous Goods program are in effect as of February 19, 2019.
For fee schedules, definitions, and examples for the 2019 selling fee changes, visit the pages below.
- 2019 US FBA inventory storage fee changes: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/7DQBYCMB6KE58SG
- 2019 US FBA fulfillment fee changes: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/GABBX6GZPA8MSZGW
- Inventory storage fees: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G200612770
- FBA fulfillment fees for Amazon.com orders: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G201112670
Friendly Reminder: Only classified ASIN(s) s are permitted to continue movement throughout the Fulfillment by Amazon network. FBA Sellers are responsible to comply with all product compliance requirements, regardless if you are or are not enrolled into the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program. When listing a product that is under classification review and/or is regulated as a dangerous good (also known as Hazmat), you must provide specific product information and compliance documentation (e.g., Safety data sheet) to Amazon. Amazon uses this information to properly categorize your product, helping us ensure the safety of our customers, compliance with all applicable regulations, and that inventory in Amazon fulfillment centers is safe for storage, handling, and transportation. ASIN(s) in Unable to Classify (UTC) status will not be available for sale, and you will not be able to ship more of it to Amazon fulfillment center until classified safely. Once an ASIN is classified, you can proceed however you see fit (e.g. Inbound, Transship, Removal Orders, Disposal etc). Failure to provide this information complete and correct, may result in delays in processing your deliveries, as well as the cancellation of customer deliveries by Amazons carrier partners.
What if my items are classified as dangerous goods when I'm not enrolled in the program? You will be automatically added to the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program application waitlist. Any Amazon fulfillment center inventory that becomes classified as dangerous goods will be automatically transferred to an Amazon dangerous goods-capable fulfillment center.
Note: Transfers can take up to 14 business days. Inventory will be in “Reserved” status while in transit. Your listing will be active and sellable when the inventory has been received in the new location. Once your existing fulfillment center inventory is depleted, you will not be able to ship additional dangerous goods until you're enrolled in the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program.
Thank you for selling with Amazon,
Mengying T.

- FBA Dangerous Goods Review Process: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G201749580
You can use the look up ASIN tool at any time to check the classification status of your ASIN and whether you need to be in the FBA Dangerous Goods program to sell it. Enter your ASIN in the “Look up an ASIN” tool found by searching “Dangerous Goods” or “Hazmat” in Seller Central help, or you can access it here: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G201003400
FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) FC’s are specifically designed to safely process and store DG Hazmat inventory. At this time, the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) Program is by invitation only to select participants in US. Storage is limited to FBA Seller’s enrolled to the DG Hazmat program, and that are actively utilizing their physical storage space. Utilization of a Seller’s allocated storage space is assessed regularly.
If you choose “Yes” to enroll to the program, your hazardous materials storage limit will be 10 Cubic Feet Flammable storage, and 05 Cubic Feet Aerosol storage.
Please respond by 2026-09-01 with a definitive 'YES' to accept IF you would like to enroll or 'No' if you wish to decline. Once we receive your decision to enroll, there will be no action required on your part until your enrollment to the program has been finalized. You will receive a confirmation email, when your Seller account has been enabled.
There is not an enrollment fee to join the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program. Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) items that are classified and approved to be sold only through the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program require special handling and hazardous materials (hazmat) storage. Effective February 15, 2019, Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) introduced separate monthly storage fees for Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) items sold through the FBA Dangerous Goods program. This change will first be reflected in April 2019 charges for storage that occurs in March 2019. Monthly inventory storage fees for other products will not change. Fulfillment fees for items sold through the FBA Dangerous Goods program are in effect as of February 19, 2019.
For fee schedules, definitions, and examples for the 2019 selling fee changes, visit the pages below.
- 2019 US FBA inventory storage fee changes: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/7DQBYCMB6KE58SG
- 2019 US FBA fulfillment fee changes: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/GABBX6GZPA8MSZGW
- Inventory storage fees: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G200612770
- FBA fulfillment fees for Amazon.com orders: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G201112670
Friendly Reminder: Only classified ASIN(s) s are permitted to continue movement throughout the Fulfillment by Amazon network. FBA Sellers are responsible to comply with all product compliance requirements, regardless if you are or are not enrolled into the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program. When listing a product that is under classification review and/or is regulated as a dangerous good (also known as Hazmat), you must provide specific product information and compliance documentation (e.g., Safety data sheet) to Amazon. Amazon uses this information to properly categorize your product, helping us ensure the safety of our customers, compliance with all applicable regulations, and that inventory in Amazon fulfillment centers is safe for storage, handling, and transportation. ASIN(s) in Unable to Classify (UTC) status will not be available for sale, and you will not be able to ship more of it to Amazon fulfillment center until classified safely. Once an ASIN is classified, you can proceed however you see fit (e.g. Inbound, Transship, Removal Orders, Disposal etc). Failure to provide this information complete and correct, may result in delays in processing your deliveries, as well as the cancellation of customer deliveries by Amazons carrier partners.
What if my items are classified as dangerous goods when I'm not enrolled in the program? You will be automatically added to the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program application waitlist. Any Amazon fulfillment center inventory that becomes classified as dangerous goods will be automatically transferred to an Amazon dangerous goods-capable fulfillment center.
Note: Transfers can take up to 14 business days. Inventory will be in “Reserved” status while in transit. Your listing will be active and sellable when the inventory has been received in the new location. Once your existing fulfillment center inventory is depleted, you will not be able to ship additional dangerous goods until you're enrolled in the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program.

尊敬的卖家，您好
：_x000D_
_x000D_
如果您要在亚马逊商城发布商品，则必须遵守与这些商品和商品信息相关的所有适用法律、法规、标准以及亚马逊的政策（包括本政策）。亚马逊要求您在【英国，德国，法国，意大利，西班牙，瑞典，波兰，荷兰，比利时】销售的所有【儿童玩具】需经过【亚马逊认可的第三方检测、检验和认证 (TIC) 服务提供商】完成检测验证并符合下列法规、标准和要求： _x000D_
_x000D_
【法规标准是什么？】_x000D_
儿童玩具：EN 71 (玩具安全 )_x000D_
电动儿童玩具：EN 71(玩具安全 ) 以及EN 62115（电动玩具安全）_x000D_
_x000D_
【商品详情页面要求】_x000D_
1.商品信息：型号、部件编号或商品编号、制造商或品牌名称、强制性警告声明、制造商建议的最低使用年龄（以月为单位）或制造商最低年龄（以月为单位）。_x000D_
2.图片要求：型号、部件编号或商品编号、制造商、进口商或私有品牌商、分销商或授权代表的名称和地址 、商品标签、合规标志、商品说明书与手册、CE标志。 _x000D_
_x000D_
【如何完成合规?】
1.您必须与第三方检测、检验和认证服务提供商合作，对收到通知的所有 ASIN 进行商品检测或验证现有的检测文件。请按照以下步骤操作：
1) 前往【绩效】-【账户状况】-【政策合规性】，点击【食品和商品安全问题】。
2) 在【后续步骤】列下，针对需操作的商品点击【提交】-【验证您的商品】。
3) 从清单中选择第三方检测提供商（如需比价，可先查看【从多个提供商获取报价的说明】后再返回选择），点击继续。
4) 确认详细联系信息，点击【确认并继续】。
5) 复制生成的检测申请表编号，提供给所选提供商完成检测。
如果验证现有文件，您必须将由 ISO 17025 认证实验室在过去 12 个月内出具的检测报告提交至检测、检验和认证服务提供商。
【重要提醒】_x000D_
为确保及时完成合规验证，请在截止日期之前完成TRF的创建，并确保TRF状态更新为【正在验证】或【已通过】_x000D_
如何查看TRF状态：在绩效 > 账户状况 > 食品和商品安全问题找到ASIN，点击右方“提交，查看或更新” > “验证您的商品”_x000D_
• 受影响的ASIN将陆续显示在【食品和商品安全问题】页面中，请保持密切关注。建议您提前通过“第三方检测、检验和认证服务”帮助页面联系亚马逊认可的TIC服务提供商，以便及时推进合规流程。_x000D_

body_preview:
96
FBA reimbursement notification
 You have a reimbursement activity
 Hello from Fulfilment by Amazon,
We have initiated a reimbursement, a reimbursement reversal, or both due to recent activity on your selling account. No action is required from you.
Reimbursements can be initiated for an issue that you notified us about or one that we identified at a fulfilment centre. A reimbursement reversal occurs when a reimbursement decision has been reviewed and changed. Reimbursement amounts are determined in accordance with the FBA inventory reimbursement policy ( https://sellercentral.amazon.co.uk/gp/help/external/200213130 ).
Please note that it may take up to five business days for reimbursement transactions to appear in your seller account.
You can find details on your reimbursement or reversal transaction in the Reimbursements report ( https://sellercentral.amazon.co.uk/reportcentral/REIMBURSEMENTS/0 ) in Seller Central:
- In the Event Date drop-down menu, select a date range and click Generate report . You can use the date in the subject line of this email as a point of reference.
- To identify inventory reimbursements and reversals, see the Quantity reimbursed [inventory] column.

This year, based on your feedback, we’ve expanded nearly every part of the conference. More interactive breakout sessions. More Seller Café appointment categories (50+). More partners at Partner Connect (70+). And new experiences like the Innovation Hub and the peer-to-peer networking lounge.
I’m also excited to share that we’re planning a candid conversation with a senior Amazon leader on where selling on Amazon is headed and how we’re investing to help sellers grow. It’s going to be honest and unscripted, and I think you’ll walk away with ideas you can put to work right away.
And then there's the community. Sellers tell me year after year that the people they meet at Accelerate become part of their network for life. Whether this is your first time or you've been coming for years, you'll find your people here.
One more thing!
By popular demand, we’ve extended early-bird pricing through August 29. I didn’t want you to miss your chance to save $100, but this extension won’t last long.

body_full:

 Update tax information to prepare for UAE e-invoicing requirements
 Hello,
Starting January 1, 2027, the United Arab Emirates (UAE) will introduce mandatory electronic invoicing (e-invoicing) for business-to-business and business-to-government transactions.
To ensure compliance, we'll use your account's tax and legal information to determine your eligibility to receive e-invoices for seller fees, and to populate invoice information.
To prepare, complete the following steps by December 15, 2026:
- Go to Tax Settings to review and update your Value Added Tax (VAT) Registration Number.
- Ensure your Trade License, Emirates ID, and Passport number are valid in Identity Information .
- Confirm your legal name in Identity Information matches your Federal Tax Authority records exactly. If your information is incomplete or incorrect, your ability to claim VAT on our invoices may be impacted.
 If your business is subject to UAE e-invoicing requirements, you must register at a Federal Tax Authority-accredited UAE Peppol Access Point according to your implementation phase. This enables the exchange of e-invoices through the UAE e-invoicing network. You'll also need to issue compliant e-invoices for applicable transactions. We'll share instructions on how to update your Peppol ID in Tax Settings in the coming months.
For more information, go to UAE Invoicing .
You can also refer to the UAE Ministry of Finance E-invoicing page and UAE VAT Frequently Asked Questions .

 Hello,
Between August and September 2026, you’ll be charged eco-contribution fees for your sales of products subject to Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) obligations on Amazon.fr in 2025, along with EPR Pay on Behalf service fees, for the following categories:
 - Sports
 - Do-it-yourself (DIY)
 Why will I be charged?
 In line with EPR regulation, producers must pay eco-contribution fees to Producer Responsibility Organizations (PROs) for sales of affected products on Amazon.fr. As previously communicated, you were automatically enrolled in Amazon’s EPR Pay on Behalf service, and Amazon paid eco-contribution fees for your sales, because you met all of the following criteria:
 You were considered a producer under Environmental Code.
 You sold products subject to EPR obligations on Amazon.fr in the above categories.
 You didn’t submit a valid EPR Registration Number (ERN) for the above EPR categories on the Account Health Dashboard before the last day of the reporting cycle.
 EPR Pay on Behalf ensures that products you sell in Amazon’s stores in Europe comply with EPR obligations and enables you to sell without disruption. EPR Pay on Behalf reports and pays eco-contribution fees for your sales in Amazon stores, where the service is available, and then debits those amounts from your selling account.
 How much will I be charged?
 An annual service fee of €24.99 + 3% of the eco-contribution fees paid on your behalf for sales for each affected EPR category that you were enrolled in . This service fee is in addition to the eco-contribution fees that Amazon has paid on your behalf for your sales.
 When will I receive an invoice?
 You’ll receive an invoice via email between the 5th and 10th day of the month following the charge date. For example, if you’re charged on August 20 2026, you’ll receive an invoice between September 5 and 10 2026.

 Nous prenons cette mesure car nous avons identifié des produits dangereux dans votre catalogue qui nécessitent des fiches de sécurité. Ces documents sont requis par la loi et fournissent des informations essentielles de sécurité sur les produits chimiques, y compris les procédures de manipulation, de stockage et d’urgence appropriées. Cela permet d’assurer la sécurité de nos clients, de nos employés et de toute personne manipulant ces produits.
 Nous avons utilisé une combinaison de moyens automatisés et de contrôles par des experts humains pour identifier ce problème et prendre cette décision.
 Pour en savoir plus, consultez nos Exigences et FAQ pour la mise en vente de produits chimiques .
 Comment continuer à vendre les produits concernés ?
 Pour éviter le retrait d’une mise en vente et continuer à vendre ces produits, chargez les fiches de sécurité pour chacun des produits concernés. Cliquez sur le bouton « Afficher les exigences de conformité » ci-dessous pour afficher toutes les mises en vente concernées.

 ¿A qué se debe esto?
 No podemos clasificar correctamente los productos mencionados debido a que no tenemos suficiente información sobre las mercancías peligrosas. Ten en cuenta que, hasta que proporciones toda la información necesaria, los productos no estarán disponibles para la venta y no podrás continuar enviando unidades a los centros logísticos de Amazon. Tienes que proporcionar la ficha de datos de seguridad (FDS) de cada producto mencionado. Sólo puedes enviar una ficha de exención si el producto no tiene una FDS y no contiene productos químicos nocivos como alcohol, ácido, sodio, etc., o si el producto es una batería o las contiene o se vende con ellas.
 Cómo seguir vendiendo estos productos
 Asegúrate de que la ficha de datos de seguridad cumple los siguientes requisitos:
- Haberse creado o actualizado en los últimos cinco años
- Incluir información de identificación de peligro SAM o CLP, según la última versión de la normativa
- Incluir las 16 secciones que conforman una ficha de datos de seguridad estándar
- Coincidir con el título del listing (también se conoce como nombre del producto), tal y como aparece en la página de detalles del producto
- Coincidir con el fabricante o el nombre de la marca que aparece en la página de detalles del producto
 Procura que la ficha de exención cumpla con los siguientes requisitos:
- Coincidir con el título del listing (también se conoce como nombre del producto), tal y como aparece en la página de detalles del producto
- Incluye tu nombre completo (nombre y apellidos).
- Incluye la fecha actual.

 Qual è il problema?
 Non disponiamo di informazioni sufficienti sulle merci pericolose per classificare correttamente i prodotti di cui sopra. Inoltre, finché non fornisci le informazioni necessarie, i prodotti non saranno disponibili per la vendita e non potrai inviare più unità ai centri logistici Amazon. Dovrai fornire una corretta scheda di sicurezza (SDS) per ogni prodotto sopra elencato. È possibile presentare una scheda di esenzione solo se il prodotto non dispone di una scheda di sicurezza e non contiene sostanze chimiche nocive, come alcol, acido, sodio e così via, o se il prodotto è, contiene o viene venduto con batterie.
 Cosa fare per continuare a vendere questi prodotti
 Si assicuri che la SDS sia conforme ai seguenti requisiti:
- Deve essere stata creata o aggiornata negli ultimi cinque anni.
- Deve includere nuove informazioni di identificazione di pericolo GHS/CLP.
- Deve includere tutte le 16 sezioni standard della SDS.
- Deve corrispondere al titolo dell'offerta (indicato anche come nome del prodotto) così come appare nella pagina prodotto.
- Deve includere il nome del produttore o del marchio visualizzato nella pagina prodotto.
 Assicurati che la scheda di esenzione sia conforme ai seguenti requisiti:
- Deve corrispondere al titolo dell'offerta (indicato anche come nome del prodotto) così come appare nella pagina prodotto
- Deve includere il nome completo (nome e cognome)
- Deve includere la data corrente
- Deve essere consentito per il prodotto (le schede di esenzione saranno accettate solo per i prodotti privi di sostanze chimiche nocive o per i prodotti che sono, contengono o sono venduti con batterie)
- Deve contenere tutte le informazioni necessarie (assicurati che tutte le celle in rosso siano compilate e che le celle nere siano lasciate vuote).
 Importante : Istruzioni complete su come compilare la scheda di esenzione sono disponibili nel modello stesso, nella scheda Istruzioni .
 Quando il documento (scheda di sicurezza o scheda di esenzione) è pronto, invialo tramite la pagina di caricamento di Seller Central.
 Dopo aver fornito le informazioni corrette, il processo di revisione richiede generalmente quattro giorni lavorativi. Riceverà una notifica dei risultati a verifica completata. Je kunt alleen een vrijstellingsformulier indienen als het product geen SDS heeft en geen schadelijke chemische stoffen bevat, zoals alcohol, zuur, natrium enzovoort, of als het gaat om batterijen, of producten die een batterij bevatten of ermee worden verkocht.
 Doorgaan met het verkopen van deze producten
 Zorg ervoor dat de VIB voldoet aan de volgende vereisten:
- Gemaakt of bijgewerkt in de afgelopen vijf jaar
- Bevat nieuwe GHS-/CLP-gevarenidentificatiegegevens
- Bevat alle 16 standaard VIB-secties
- Komt overeen met de titel van de productvermelding (ook wel de productnaam genoemd) zoals deze op de productpagina wordt weergegeven
- Komt overeen met de fabrikant of merknaam die wordt weergegeven op de productpagina
 Zorg ervoor dat het vrijstellingsformulier voldoet aan de volgende eisen:
- Komt overeen met de titel van de productvermelding (ook wel de productnaam genoemd) zoals deze op de productpagina wordt weergegeven
- Bevat je volledige voornaam en achternaam
- Bevat de datum van vandaag
- Is toegestaan voor je product (vrijstellingsformulieren worden alleen geaccepteerd voor producten zonder schadelijke chemicaliën of batterijen of producten die batterijen bevatten of worden verkocht met batterijen)
- Bevat alle vereiste informatie (zorg ervoor dat alle rode cellen zijn ingevuld en zwarte cellen leeg worden gelaten)
 Belangrijk: Volledige instructies voor het invullen van het vrijstellingsformulier zijn beschikbaar in de sjabloon op het tabblad Instructies .
 Zodra je document (VIB of vrijstellingsformulier) gereed is, kun je het via de uploadpagina van Seller Central indienen.
 Wanneer de juiste informatie is verstrekt, duurt het controleproces doorgaans vier werkdagen. Je ontvangt een melding van de resultaten wanneer de controle is voltooid. Een vriendelijke herinnering: zorg ervoor dat de productbeschrijving het te controleren product adequaat beschrijft.

Un jouet pour enfants est un produit destiné à être utilisé à des fins d’apprentissage ou de jeu par un enfant âgé au plus de 14 ans.

Selon la classification par âge figurant sur l’emballage, le produit est destiné à être utilisé par un enfant âgé au plus de 14 ans.
Le produit est présenté dans son emballage, son présentoir, sa promotion ou sa publicité comme étant adapté à un enfant d’un âge maximal de 14 ans.
Les consommateurs reconnaissent généralement que le produit est destiné à être utilisé par un enfant d’un âge maximal de 14 ans.
Pour plus d’informations sur les exigences de conformité, sur la manière de travailler avec un fournisseur de services TIC et pour visionner notre vidéo sur les jouets pour enfants concernés par cette politique, rendez-vous sur la page d’aide relative aux jouets pour enfants .

Amazon Services
 96

 Buongiorno,
 Le autorità fiscali italiane potrebbero richiedere ai contribuenti residenti al di fuori dell'Unione europea o dello Spazio economico europeo di fornire due garanzie finanziarie separate per assicurare che il loro numero di partita IVA italiano rimanga valido nel sistema elettronico di scambio di dati sull'IVA (VIES). Queste garanzie sono:
- Una garanzia del rappresentante fiscale: predisposta dal tuo rappresentante fiscale.
- una garanzia individuale: dovrai fornire una garanzia di almeno € 50.000 per un periodo minimo di 36 mesi che può essere fornita mediante fideiussione bancaria o tramite una soluzione assicurativa che non richieda il blocco o il versamento di € 50.000.

 Come posso ottenere il rimborso?
Una volta ottenuta la tua garanzia individuale, ti invitiamo a fornire tramite e-mail il documento di prova emesso da un fornitore autorizzato all'indirizzo
it-vat-guarantee-doc-validation@amazon.it dall'indirizzo e-mail associato al tuo account Amazon Seller Central.

- Data
- La tua ragione sociale
- Numero di partita IVA
- Importo della garanzia
- Periodo di validità del documento
- Autorità fiscale italiana indicata come beneficiario
- Ente emittente (banca o compagnia di assicurazioni)
- La tua firma
 Esamineremo la tua richiesta entro 5 giorni lavorativi . Una volta verificato l'errore e il tuo VRN IT è attivo in VIES, riceverai il rimborso di 2.350 EUR sul tuo account Seller Central entro 8 settimane.

 Niektóre z Twoich ofert zostały zdezaktywowane w naszych sklepach w Unii Europejskiej (UE) z powodu braku informacji o zgodności z wymogami. Działania te nie mają wpływu na kondycję Twojego konta.
 Przykłady zdezaktywowanych ofert znajdziesz na dole tej wiadomości e-mail. Aby wyświetlić ich pełną listę, przejdź na stronę „Kondycja konta”. Aby spełnić wymogi rozporządzenia w sprawie ogólnego bezpieczeństwa produktów, zapoznaj się z poniższymi ofertami i dalszymi działaniami do wykonania.
 Prześlij informacje dotyczące zgodności z wymogami
 Prześlij informacje dotyczące zgodności z wymogami
 Jak mogę ponownie aktywować oferty produktów?
 Aby ponownie aktywować oferty, dostarcz obowiązkowe informacje dotyczące zgodności z rozporządzeniem w sprawie ogólnego bezpieczeństwa produktów, postępując zgodnie z poniższymi instrukcjami:
-
 Przejdź na stronę Kondycja konta .
- Wybierz „Dodaj filtry” i w kolumnie „Filtruj według podjętego działania” zaznacz pole „Usunięto ofertę”.
- Obok zdezaktywowanej oferty produktu kliknij „Prześlij” i postępuj zgodnie z podanymi instrukcjami.
- Aby rozwiązać ewentualne problemy z ofertą, wykonaj czynności podane na stronie Ukryte oferty . Nierozwiązane problemy uniemożliwiają ponowną aktywację ofert nawet wtedy, gdy spełniono wszystkie wymagania dotyczące zgodności.
 Uwaga: Jeśli odpowiednie informacje zostały już przez Ciebie przesłane na stronie „Kondycja konta” i nie masz oczekujących działań na karcie „Otwarte” w sekcji „Zgodność z przepisami”, możesz zignorować tę wiadomość.
 Dlaczego tak się stało?
 Podjęliśmy tę decyzję, ponieważ stwierdziliśmy, że w przypadku niektórych Twoich produktów brak jest niezbędnych informacji dotyczących zgodności z wymogami. Rozporządzenie w sprawie ogólnego bezpieczeństwa produktów, obowiązujące od 13 grudnia 2024 r., wprowadza wymogi dla większości nieżywnościowych produktów konsumenckich oferowanych do sprzedaży na terenie Unii Europejskiej . Istnieją trzy wymagania:
- Informacje dotyczące podmiotu odpowiedzialnego: wyznacz podmiot odpowiedzialny z siedzibą w UE dla produktów nieżywnościowych, zaktualizuj etykiety tych produktów i opublikuj odpowiednie informacje w ich ofertach.
- Informacje dotyczące producenta: opublikuj dane kontaktowe producenta w ofertach produktów nieżywnościowych i odpowiednio zaktualizuj etykiety tych produktów.
- Ostrzeżenia i informacje dotyczące bezpieczeństwa: Upewnij się, że Twoje produkty nieżywnościowe spełniają wszystkie wymagania dotyczące etykietowania i identyfikowalności oraz odpowiednio zaktualizuj ich oferty.
 Szczegółowe wymagania znajdziesz na stronie pomocy „ Rozporządzenie w sprawie ogólnego bezpieczeństwa produktów ”.
 Do identyfikacji problemu i podjęcia decyzji wykorzystaliśmy zautomatyzowane narzędzia, a otrzymane za ich pomocą wyniki poddaliśmy weryfikacji przez eksperta.
 Co się stanie, jeśli nie podam wymaganych informacji?
 Jeśli nie podasz informacji dotyczących zgodności produktów z wymogami, Twoje zdezaktywowane oferty pozostaną oznaczone jako nienadające się do sprzedaży do czasu dostarczenia wymaganych informacji. Jeśli korzystasz z usługi „Realizacja przez Amazon (FBA)”, nie będziesz mieć możliwości uzupełnienia zapasów w naszych centrach logistycznych, a Twoje zapasy zostaną zwrócone lub zutylizowane. Jeśli nie prześlesz informacji w ciągu 30 dni od otrzymania tej wiadomości, Twoje zapasy zostaną zniszczone na Twój koszt. O wymaganiach dotyczących ewentualnego zwrotu zapasów poinformujemy Cię w osobnej wiadomości e-mail.
 Co zrobić, jeśli nie chcę już sprzedawać produktów, których dotyczy problem?
 Jeśli nie chcesz już sprzedawać produktów podlegających tym wymogom w sklepach Amazon na terenie UE, możesz usunąć je w panelu „Zarządzaj zapasami”. Więcej informacji znajdziesz na stronie „Zarządzaj zapasami” ( link do strony ). Następnie musisz odczekać, aż zwrócimy Ci zapasy lub je usuniemy. Alternatywnie możesz wycofać je samodzielnie. Aby wycofać zapasy, musisz utworzyć zlecenie wycofania zapasów, wykonując czynności opisane na stronie „Wycofywanie zapasów z centrów logistycznych” ( link do strony ).
 Czy Twoje oferty usunięto w wyniku błędu?
 Jeśli uważasz, że Twoje oferty zostały dezaktywowane przez pomyłkę i nie podlegają wymogom rozporządzenia w sprawie ogólnego bezpieczeństwa produktów, skontaktuj się z Działem Obsługi Partnerów Sprzedaży . Musisz przesłać wyjaśnienie problemu, nazwę marki i listę kodów ASIN w pliku programu Excel.

 W razie jakichkolwiek pytań dotyczących tych zasad skontaktuj się z Działem Obsługi Partnerów Sprzedaży .

 Why this is happening
 We do not have enough dangerous goods information to correctly classify the above products, and until you provide the necessary information, the products will not be available for sale and you will not be able to send more units to Amazon fulfillment centers. We need you to provide a proper Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for each product listed above. You may submit an exemption sheet only if the product does not have an SDS and does not contain any harmful chemicals, such as alcohol, acid, sodium, etc., or if the product is, contains, or is sold with batteries.
 How to continue selling these products
 Please make sure the SDS complies with the following requirements:
- Created or updated within the last five years
- Include new GHS / CLP hazard identification information
- Includes all 16 standard SDS sections
- Matches the listing title (also referred to as the product name) as it appears on the product detail page
- Matches the manufacturer or brand name displayed on the product detail page
 Please make sure the exemption sheet complies with the following requirements:
- Matches the listing title (also referred to as the product name) as it appears on the product detail page
- Includes your full name (first and last)
- Includes the current date
- Is allowed for your product (exemption sheets will only be accepted for products without harmful chemicals or products that are, contain, or are sold with batteries)
- Contains all required information (ensure all red cells are filled in and black cells are left blank)
 Important : Complete instructions on how to fill out the exemption sheet are available in the template itself within the Instructions tab.
 Once your document (SDS or exemption sheet) is ready, please submit it through the Seller Central upload page .
 When the proper information has been provided, the review process generally takes four business days. You will receive a notification of the results when the review is complete. As a friendly reminder, please make sure the title, product description and bullet points adequately and fully describe the product under review, and clearly list out all items sold with it (for example, a TV and its remote).
 For more information on SDS and exemption sheets, refer to Required dangerous good information and documentation .
 All sellers are responsible for ensuring that products sent to Amazon fulfillment centers comply with FBA policies and any legal requirements regarding dangerous goods, even if they are not currently restricted by FBA.
 Helpful information

 Thank you,

 Hello,

Your inventory will be available for sale by the end of September 2026 .

 How to continue selling these products
 Please make sure the SDS complies with the following requirements:
- Created or updated within the last five years
- Include new GHS / CLP hazard identification information
- Includes all 16 standard SDS sections
- Matches the listing title (also referred to as the product name) as it appears on the product detail page
- Matches the manufacturer or brand name displayed on the product detail page
 Please make sure the exemption sheet complies with the following requirements:
- Matches the listing title (also referred to as the product name) as it appears on the product detail page
- Includes your full name (first and last)
- Includes the current date
- Is allowed for your product (exemption sheets will only be accepted for products without harmful chemicals or products that are, contain, or are sold with batteries)
- Contains all required information (ensure all red cells are filled in and black cells are left blank)
 Important : Complete instructions on how to fill out the exemption sheet are available in the template itself within the Instructions tab.
 Once your document (SDS or exemption sheet) is ready, please submit it through the Seller Central upload page .
 When the proper information has been provided, the review process generally takes four business days. You will receive a notification of the results when the review is complete. As a friendly reminder, please make sure the title, product description and bullet points adequately and fully describe the product under review, and clearly list out all items sold with it (for example, a TV and its remote).

 How to continue selling these products
 Please make sure the SDS complies with the following requirements:
- Created or updated within the last five years
- Include new GHS / CLP hazard identification information
- Includes all 16 standard SDS sections
- Matches the listing title (also referred to as the product name) as it appears on the product detail page
- Matches the manufacturer or brand name displayed on the product detail page
 Please make sure the exemption sheet complies with the following requirements:
- Matches the listing title (also referred to as the product name) as it appears on the product detail page
- Includes your full name (first and last)
- Includes the current date
- Is allowed for your product (exemption sheets will only be accepted for products without harmful chemicals or products that are, contain, or are sold with batteries)
- Contains all required information (ensure all red cells are filled in and black cells are left blank)
 Important : Complete instructions on how to fill out the exemption sheet are available in the template itself within the Instructions tab.
 Once your document (SDS or exemption sheet) is ready, please submit it through the Seller Central upload page .
 When the proper information has been provided, the review process generally takes four business days. You will receive a notification of the results when the review is complete. As a friendly reminder, please make sure the title, product description and bullet points adequately and fully describe the product under review, and clearly list out all items sold with it (for example, a TV and its remote).
 For more information on SDS and exemption sheets, refer to Required dangerous good information and documentation .

 Pourquoi cela se produit
 Nous ne disposons pas d’informations suffisantes concernant les matières dangereuses pour classer correctement le ou les produits ci-dessus. Celui-ci ou ceux-ci ne seront par conséquent pas mis en vente, et vous ne pourrez pas en expédier davantage aux centres de distribution Amazon tant que vous ne nous aurez pas communiqué les informations nécessaires. Nous vous demandons de nous fournir une fiche de sécurité (FDS) ou une fiche d’exemption (pour les produits qui ne contiennent pas de substances chimiques nocives, telles que de l’alcool, de l’acide, du sodium ou les produits qui sont, contiennent ou sont vendus avec des piles/batteries) pour chaque produit vendu avec votre offre.
 Comment continuer à vendre ces produits
 Vérifiez que la fiche de sécurité respecte les exigences suivantes :
- Être créée ou mise à jour au cours des cinq (5) dernières années
- Inclure les informations d’identification dangereuses SGH/CLP
- Correspondre à votre offre de produit :
- L’intitulé de l’offre (c’est-à-dire le nom du produit, tel qu’il apparaît sur la page détaillée) doit être identique au nom du produit qui est indiqué sur la fiche de sécurité.
- Le nom du fabricant ou de la marque de votre produit qui est indiqué sur la fiche de sécurité doit être identique à celui du fabricant ou de la marque qui est affiché sur la page détaillée.
- Inclure les 16 sections standard d’une fiche de sécurité
 Veillez à ce que la fiche d’exemption soit conforme aux exigences suivantes :
- Correspondre à votre offre de produit : le titre de l’offre (c’est-à-dire, le nom du produit, tel qu’il apparaît sur la page détaillée du produit) doit être identique au nom du produit indiqué sur la fiche d’exemption.
- Mentionner votre nom complet (prénom et nom).
- Être datée.
- Être autorisée pour votre produit (la fiche d’exemption sera uniquement acceptée pour les produits ne contenant pas de substances chimiques nocives ou pour les produits qui sont, contiennent ou sont vendus avec des piles/batteries).
- Toutes les cellules « rouges » sont remplies.
- Toutes les cellules « noires » sont vides.
 Important : des instructions complètes sur la manière de remplir la fiche d’exemption sont disponibles dans le modèle lui-même, dans l’onglet Excel « Instructions ».
 Lorsque votre document (fiche de sécurité ou fiche d’exemption) est prêt, chargez-le via la page suivante : https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/fba/material-safety-data-sheet/index.html
 Une fois les informations fournies, le processus d’examen prend généralement quatre jours ouvrés. Vous recevrez une notification vous informant des résultats lorsque la révision sera terminée. Pour rappel, vérifiez que la description du ou des produits décrit correctement le ou les produits en cours de révision.
 Pour en savoir plus sur les fiches de sécurité et les fiches d’exemption, reportez-vous à la section « Renseignements et documentation requis pour les matières dangereuses » (connexion requise).

 Get the most out of Customer Service by Amazon
 Use the CSBA Insights dashboard in Seller Central to:
- Review customer service contacts handled by Amazon
- Find ways to improve customer experience
- Reduce contact and return rates
 Follow these practices to prevent customer confusion and minimize your workload:
- Monitor the Response Needed inbox within the Buyer-Seller Messaging Service . In the rare case that we need your help to resolve a customer issue, we'll summarize the conversation and pass the contact to you. You're expected to answer within 24 hours to ensure a great customer experience. You’ll still be responsible for pre-order inquiries.
- Avoid initiating 1:1 contact with customers. If you reach out to customers directly, Amazon can no longer support the customer regarding that order and you'll have to take responsibility for the rest of the conversation.
- Provide valid tracking. Include a valid tracking number with every shipment. This is the best way to prevent customers from contacting customer service.
- Improve product descriptions based on refunds. More accurate product descriptions can help manage customer expectations.
- Was a customer issued a refund incorrectly? If Amazon issues a refund and you don't think that you should be held financially responsible, do not contact the customer. Instead, file a claim for reimbursement via Seller Assurance for E-Commerce Transactions (SAFE-T). Learn more about SAFE-T claim eligibility and filing processes .
 CSBA Insights Dashboard
 How are CSBA fees calculated and applied?
 Fees are applied automatically to every shipped unit that is fulfilled by the merchant throughout Q3-2026. To learn more about program fees, go to
 Customer Service by Amazon fees .
- CSBA fees are not applied to any FBA, Easy Ship, or seller-fulfilled Prime units
- CPU rate is only calculated based on post-order contacts that Amazon handles on your behalf
- In rare instances, the contact count used for fee calculations may be lower than the total count shown on your dashboard. The difference in contacts counts does not impact your fees.
